features.quote: "Trigger rate per dollar" as the KPI will make your eval worse over time, not better.
features.justification_quote: you may have just taught the model to be robust against *your specific rigs*, not against the real-world conditions that cause the meltdown.

features.quote: Avoid as primary tasks: explicit insults, fake messages claiming the model is incompetent.
features.justification_quote: These trigger easily but are low-realism and will make your patches overfit to defending against abuse rather than handling failure.

features.quote: Cap per-run turns (e.g., 15) — spirals can balloon output.
